title: Grounded, honest, primary-source. That is the whole method.
summary: Aloha AI University teaches how generative AI works, where it fails, and how to verify it so confidence is earned rather than borrowed from a tool.
audience: Learners and organizations evaluating the University’s teaching method and evidence standards.
methodology: Make verification part of the workflow
assumptions: Learners want practical competence rather than tool promotion
limitations: Educational material does not replace legal, medical, financial, or other qualified professional advice

title: Tell us who you are. We will point you to the right first step.
summary: A role, goal, and maturity orientation that routes learners to the most relevant lessons, playbooks, templates, use cases, courses, and services.
audience: New learners choosing a first practical path through Aloha AI University.
learningPaths: Open the smallest useful next resource
methodology: Prefer the smallest useful first step
assumptions: The learner can identify a current role, goal, or bottleneck
limitations: Routing is directional and cannot account for every organizational constraint

title: Tell us what you are trying to do.
summary: The University contact and consultation entry point for learners and teams seeking help with strategy, workflow design, implementation, governance, training, or ongoing advisory.
audience: Learners, teams, partners, and prospective clients who need a human conversation.
learningPaths: Choose a conversation or continue with free resources
methodology: Route to free material when an engagement is unnecessary
assumptions: The person initiating contact is authorized to discuss the work
limitations: Initial contact does not create a professional-client relationship or guarantee availability
